jobs.title: Senior Design Manager (Architecture)
jobs.content:
Oasis Development Co is building the next generation of mixed-use destinations in the Kingdom. We are hiring a Senior Design Manager to lead design governance across complex programmes.

What you'll do

  • Lead design governance and multidisciplinary design coordination across complex infrastructure programmes.
  • Manage senior client and stakeholder relationships and oversee project delivery.
  • Drive value engineering, quality assurance and design controls.

What you need

  • Degree in architecture and strong Saudi project experience.
  • Demonstrated team leadership and people management.
  • Experience with design management and programme delivery.

jobs.title: Project Delivery Director
jobs.content:
Oasis Development Co seeks a Project Delivery Director to own end-to-end delivery across a portfolio of destination projects in the GCC.

  • Lead multidisciplinary project delivery and consultant integration.
  • Own programme controls, risk and reporting to the board.
  • Build and manage a high-performing delivery leadership team.

jobs.content: Design Review Lead role at Oasis Development Co coordinating design reviews with consultants and authorities.
